answer_1.quote: We group the tasks into three classes: Classification Tasks (Table ), QA tasks (Table ) and other language generation tasks (Table ). These tasks cover a total of 28 different categories and span 72 unique datasets.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs across classification, QA, and language generation tasks using automatic metrics.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance of classification tasks using micro, macro and weighted F1 scores, and for QA and language generation tasks we use the ROUGE-L metric. We report the ROUGE-L, Exact Match (EM), and ANLS -Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity
